newsitem.title: UK: UK's Postern Group launches private equity fund.
newsitem.headline: UK's Postern Group launches private equity fund.

text.p: The Postern Group has announced the launch of a 15 million stg private equity fund to be managed by Postern Fund Management Ltd.
The group, formed in 1991, provides corporate recovery services whereby management teams are brought in to turn around distressed companies.

It now has five full time executive directors, five assistant directors, 32 associates under contract and access to some 150 other associates. Three full time executives are dedicated to corporate recovery services.

A statement from Postern said its new fund would be able to commit funds quickly. Sponsored by Campbell Lutyens & Co and raised from city institutions including NatWest Ventures, Equitable Life, Condover and Pantheon, it will be able to invest in the U.K. and Europe.
Since its formation Postern Executive Group has completed more than 30 assignments in 16 industry sectors operating in six countries. Only four have failed to survive.
Postern's managing director is Trevor Swete, who headed Hill Samuel's corporate finance drive in the 1980s. Tony Henfrey is executive director.
